reason: Alert 1 (java/xss): alert-TP — resolved sink value is the user-provided value from bar, which comes directly from param obtained via URL decoding. The sink expression at L116-L122 concatenates the decoded value into HTML output via encodeForHTML, but the input itself remains attacker-controlled. Since the value originates from user input and flows directly to the HTML response, it constitutes a cross-site scripting vulnerability despite encoding. All other alerts are either structural FPs or unrelated. Case TP: at least one alert is alert-TP.

evidence.note: User input from cookie is decoded and concatenated into HTML response via encodeForHTML, preserving attacker control over content
